testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All buttons, links, hero CTAs, navigation elements, quiz buttons, FAQ headers, and language switchers MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: All icons and interactive elements must have proper accessibility roles and aria labels.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for body, 3:1 for large display headers against dark void background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all HTML/CSS files maintain strict responsiveness, mobile-first design, and clean semantics.
Utilize real screenshots from /screenshots/app_screen_1.png through app_screen_4.png in feature showcases.
Include robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and JSON-LD structured data for maximal SEO quality.
Never use raw transparent header without blur; use glassmorphism backdrop-filter for navigation.
